title: Young Boy Showing Six Fingers, Birthday Yard - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white outdoor snapshot capturing a young boy standing in a residential yard, proudly holding up six fingers to mark his age. He is dressed in classic post-WWII American children's attire: a light short-sleeved collared shirt tucked into high-waisted, pleated trousers secured with a dark leather belt, paired with dress shoes. In the background, a thick ivy-covered post or tree trunk and a neighboring suburban house frame the scene under bright sunlight.
